title: Tamsin and the Inventory
author: Yara Dunmore
blurb: Theo Sandoval, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
